entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I want to return this ridiculous jersey I just bought. This is completely unacceptable and I want my money back immediately.

I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the item. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is there a defect, or is it a sizing preference?

Don't you start with your script! It's the wrong size! Your website's sizing chart is a complete joke. The jersey is way too tight, I can barely breathe in it! I followed your guide and this is what I get? I want a refund, and I want to speak to a manager right now.

I understand your frustration completely, and I apologize that the sizing didn't meet your expectations. There's no need to speak to a manager; I am fully authorized to resolve this for you right now.
Oh, really? So you're going to give me my money back or are you going to waste more of my time? I'm one click away from leaving a review that will make your whole company look like a scam.

I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you. Our jerseys fall under our 10-day return policy, and since you just received it, you are unfortunately outside that window. We can process an exchange for a larger size, or if you prefer, a full refund to your original payment method. Which would you prefer?
A full refund. I'm not taking another chance on your sizing. Just get me my money back.

Of course. I have just initiated the return process and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. You should receive it within the next minute or two. Simply print that label, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse scans the return, your refund will be processed.
Okay... I just got the email. So that's it? No hidden fees or restocking charges?
That's it. It's a completely free return, and there are absolutely no hidden fees. We want to make sure the process is as simple as possible for you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a wonderful day.
